{{Quote|I'm Kinto Symms, Imperial infiltration. I've been monitoring the Republic forces and bombarding them with misinformation.|Kinto Symms|<ref name="Open Season" />}}
'''Kinto Symms''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] soldier of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed at the [[Jagged Plains Imperial Garrison]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], from where he tapped into Republic communications in order to spread misinformation - from claiming poisonous food to be edible to claiming that [[Pantran whitefang]]s could be trained to serve the Republic scouts.
